customManagers.description: actions/checkout `repository:` + `ref: <sha> # <branch>` pins (the coding-tooling checkouts) are invisible to the github-actions manager; track them as git-refs digests so they move with the matching `uses:` pin in the grouped digest PR.

packageRules.description: rust-kernels crates share types and must move to the same revision together
Crates from one git repository must move together; single-crate digest bumps split the graph across revisions.
